name: Marshal Marris
summary: At Lakeshire's bridge, Marshal Marris rallies a thin guard against the Blackrock advance. With Stormwind's army absent, he calls on visiting fighters to slow the orcs in the Redridge Mountains.

sections.title: A Town Under Siege
sections.body: Gnolls press from the west and the Blackrock clan from the east. Marshal Marris holds the guard line at Lakeshire's main bridge, though supplies run low and his soldiers are stretched thin. Stormwind has sent no royal reinforcements, so Marris must keep the town from being overrun.

sections.title: Breaking the Blackrock Vanguard
sections.body: Marshal Marris knows defense alone cannot save Redridge. He orders strikes on the orc camps, sending fighters against Blackrock warriors and shadowcasters. Then they must face Tharil'zun, the commander holding the ruins of Stonewatch Keep. Marris means to break the orcs' command before they overwhelm Lakeshire.

aliases: who is the guard at lakeshire bridge
faq.answer: Marshal Marris commands Lakeshire's defense. He keeps watch near the western end of the town's bridge and works to fortify the settlement against attack.

faq.q: Why is Marshal Marris hiring independent adventurers?
faq.answer: Stormwind has sent too few reinforcements to the Redridge Mountains, leaving Lakeshire's guard outnumbered. With gnolls and Blackrock orcs pressing in, Marris hires mercenaries to strike at both threats.

faq.q: What threats is Marshal Marris fighting against?
faq.answer: Gnolls trouble the outskirts, but Marshal Marris chiefly fights the Blackrock orcs holding Stonewatch Keep. Tharil'zun commands them, and their shadowcasters add to the danger facing Lakeshire and the kingdom.

faq.q: Is Marshal Marris related to Nathanos Marris?
faq.answer: Marris is a surname found in the human kingdoms of Lordaeron and Stormwind. No record confirms a family tie between Marshal Marris in Redridge and Nathanos Marris, the famed ranger from the north.

faq.q: What is Marris's plan to defeat the Blackrock clan?
faq.answer: Marris orders fighters to kill Blackrock infantry and gather magical components from their shadowcasters. They must also enter Stonewatch Keep and kill Tharil'zun.

faq.q: Where can Marshal Marris be found?
faq.answer: Marshal Marris can be found at the bridge near the center of Lakeshire, in the Redridge Mountains.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Marshal Marris shows how exposed its rural lands are when Stormwind cannot act. Lakeshire must fight to survive on its own.
As a human of the kingdom, you can see in Marris a frontier guard holding the line against the Old Horde's remnants.
As a warrior, you know the value of direct martial discipline. Marris sends front-line fighters into Stonewatch to face seasoned Blackrock veterans.
